Mara (CSM): Kicking off NorthStar QBR prep — primary asks: token econ snapshot, one-off embed spike scenario, and a short enablement playbook. Who can pull a 60d daily by feature?
Finn (FinOps): Can we also get committed credits remaining + baseline $/mo estimate? Propose soft alert at +30% vs baseline and critical at +60% or credits <15%.
Dev (Data): I got this. SQL I'll run: ```SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) day, feature, SUM(tokens) tokens FROM usage WHERE account='northstar' AND ts >= now() - interval '60 days' GROUP BY day, feature ORDER BY day;``` ETA ~90m.
Amir (AM): FYI customer starts a similarity-search pilot next week; embed traffic could 1.8-2.5x for a short window. They'll want a "cost-safe" rollout checklist.
Dev (Data): Raw last30d: gen=49,800,000 tokens, embed=17,200,000 tokens. Uploading CSV to /shared/qbr/northstar_tokens_1791.csv now.
qbr-bot: File uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/northstar_tokens_1791.csv. Baseline forecast (+12%) appended.
Mara (CSM): Action items: Dev -> two forecast variants (2x embed one-month spike + steady 6% QoQ), Finn -> one-pager with alert thresholds + auto-mitigation knobs, Amir -> schedule 45m enablement (batching + KV cache) and collect dev/test traffic windows. I'll assemble slides and circulate by tomorrow 10am PT.
qbr-bot: Checklist updated: "NorthStar QBR: cost scenarios + enablement" assigned to Mara, due in 15 hours. :bell:
